---
title: Object Interaction
---

Use the common select, touch, grab, move, and release hooks with an interactive object.
The cube's color reflects its current interaction state (idle yellow, ray-selected blue, and direct-touched green).

### Desktop Controls (Hands Mode)

- **Move Hand:** Use <kbd>W</kbd>, <kbd>A</kbd>, <kbd>S</kbd>, <kbd>D</kbd> to move forward, left, backward, and right.
- **Elevate Hand:** Use <kbd>Q</kbd> and <kbd>E</kbd> to move down and up.
- **Switch Active Hand:** Press <kbd>T</kbd> to toggle between the left and right hand.
- **Interact / Pinch:** Left-click or press <kbd>Space</kbd> to pinch, grab, and move the object.
- **Rotate Camera:** Right-click and drag the mouse.

### XR Controls

- **Direct Touch / Grab:** Reach out with your hand to touch or grab the cube.
- **Distant Manipulation:** Point and ray-pinch to select, move, or rotate the cube from a distance.
